test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

A little girl opened the door of the hut.

options.text: The door of the hut is opened by a little girl.
The door of the hut has been opened by a little girl.
A little girl of the hut was opened by the door.
The door of the hut was opened by a little girl.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The door of the hut was opened by a little girl.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are some rules to keep in mind when changing a sentence from active to passive voice.
 
• The **object **in the active voice sentence becomes a **subject **in the passive voice.
 
• "**The door**" in the active voice becomes the **subject **of the sentence in the passive voice.
 
• The girl becomes **the agent** who does the action in the passive voice
 
• The given sentence in active voice is in the **past tense **so the passive voice sentence will have the structure **was/were + past participle of the verb**.

**The correct sentence is**: *The door of the hut **was opened** by a little girl.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.
